method: Read-only independent review of the replay repair, followed by the answer-arrival reveal extension; no competing app tests.

findings.issue: README wording could imply two total searches per cell instead of two setup searches plus one replay.
findings.resolution: States three searches per cell explicitly: two seed searches and one replay.

assessment: Existing sibling-input helper suppresses redundant events. Answer reveal reads current focus with attachment/ancestry guards; delayed-callback tests cover newer inside/outside focus. Native runner clearly separates real local keyword retrieval from controlled answers.
closeout_evidence_review: Reviewed native result/lifecycle, 148-test output, guide, audit and links; one wording clarification applied.
